name: The World of AI: Robotics Models catalogue from Hugging Face Hub
title: The World of AI: Robotics Models catalogue from Hugging Face Hub
answer: The World of AI publishes a Robotics Models catalogue drawn from the Hugging Face Hub public API. It lists the 1000 most downloaded open robotics models, with licence, downloads, and release date, refreshed daily and sorted by all time downloads. Each model links to its own Hub page. The page also mentions vision-language-action models. Last verified 2026-09-29. For AI in transportation, it is a discovery index for open robotics models, not a transportation specific study, so it helps with model availability and licensing checks.

sections.body: The World of AI publishes this page as part of its AI ecosystem section on technology and core infrastructure. It is a catalogue or index page for Robotics Models, not an article or report. Its stated scope is the 1000 most downloaded open robotics models on the Hugging Face Hub, with licence, downloads, and release date, refreshed daily. The page says its source is the Hugging Face Hub public API, sorted by all time downloads, and that every model links to its own Hub page. It carries a last verified date of 2026-09-29. The supplied text also includes site wide search information, citation guidance, and promotional blocks for books and consulting services.
sections.heading: What this source is

sections.body: The page presents a catalogue of the 1000 most downloaded open robotics models on the Hugging Face Hub. For each model it says the catalogue provides licence, downloads, and release date. The list is refreshed daily and sorted by all time downloads. The source is the Hugging Face Hub public API, and every model links to its own Hub page. The page also refers to vision-language-action models, though the supplied text truncates that description. A last verified date of 2026-09-29 appears. Beyond the catalogue, the text describes a site wide search that covers every published page, all built from the same database. That database is said to include state AI laws, a lawsuit tracker, a glossary, a tools directory, AI companies, a research library, an MCP server registry, compliance frameworks, sources, people, calculators, and weekly digests. The page offers citation guidance. It also carries promotional blocks for books by Stephen R. Jordan, for SRJ Consulting and Services, and for a novel titled The AI Lawyer, out 17 August 2026. It describes The World of AI as an atlas of artificial intelligence covering what the law says, who is suing whom, and what the words mean, with every page rebuilt daily from primary sources and carrying its last verified date. It says the site is free to read, free to cite, and free to query.
sections.heading: What it says

sections.body: The source states that the catalogue covers the 1000 most downloaded open robotics models on the Hugging Face Hub. It says each entry includes licence, downloads, and release date. It says the list is refreshed daily and sorted by all time downloads. It names the Hugging Face Hub public API as its source. It gives a last verified date of 2026-09-29. It says every model links to its own Hub page. It mentions The AI Lawyer novel with an out date of 17 August 2026. The supplied text gives no model names, performance figures, or transportation specific numbers.
sections.heading: Figures and claims worth noting

sections.body: A reader following AI in transportation can use this source as a discovery index for open robotics models. It points to the Hugging Face Hub and reports licence, downloads, and release date, which may help with finding and checking models for robotics projects. It also indicates that vision-language-action models are tracked in the Robotics Models section. However, the source does not discuss transportation, autonomous vehicles, logistics, or any industry application. Its value is therefore limited to model discovery and licensing context, not to transportation specific evidence or analysis.
sections.heading: What it means for AI in Transportation

sections.body: This is a catalogue or landing page, not a research report or case study. It does not cover model performance, safety, deployment, or transportation use cases. It relies on the Hugging Face Hub public API and all time downloads, so it is partial to open models on that Hub and to a popularity metric. The supplied text truncates the vision-language-action description. The page includes promotional blocks for books and consulting services, so parts are commercial. It is dated by a last verified date of 2026-09-29 and is refreshed daily according to the text.
